purpose: Per-campaign classification of PUBLISHED_FOLLOWER_MODE vs REACTIVE_PLAYBOOK_MODE evidence (DECISION 4). Does NOT assert Farouk never uses limits or deliberately traps followers.

mode_definitions.PUBLISHED_FOLLOWER_MODE: posts a pre-planned zone + legs + stop that a follower can mirror as resting limits
mode_definitions.REACTIVE_PLAYBOOK_MODE: reacts to live structure; posted levels are commentary, actual entries private/discretionary

evidence_for_follower_mode: explicit zone + 3 entry points + posted stop
'if your SL entry got hit, I'll send another trade' = follower-directed
evidence_for_reactive_mode: only near leg filled; mid/far never reached -> his own entry may differ
posted pip milestones (90/130 pips) framed as running commentary
personal stop UNKNOWN; structural invalidation NOT stated
campaigns.caveat: does NOT assert limits-only or trap; both readings fit

campaigns.posted_structure: 3-point zone + posted follower stop 4144; near leg = MARKET_AT_SIGNAL_CLOSE
evidence_for_reactive_mode: near leg modelled as market-at-signal-close, not a resting limit -> reactive entry
retrospective .mov breakdown posted after = teaching, not signal
campaigns.caveat: market-at-signal near leg leans reactive; posted zone leans follower; HYBRID

aggregate_note: 2/2 campaigns HYBRID_MODE_SUPPORTED with PRIVATE_EXECUTION_UNKNOWN. Sample far too small for any general claim about his mode. Do NOT generalise.
